title: TELITI Indonesian evaluation item
description: One annotated Indonesian job advertisement. Files are JSONL: one object per line. See ml/validate_eval_set.py and MVP_PLAN.md step 1.5.

id.description: id-holdout-0001 for real items. SYNTHETIC-0001 for fixtures, which must never produce a reportable number.

text.description: The ad VERBATIM. Keep emoji, typos, line breaks, ALL-CAPS. Do not tidy it: the messiness is the signal, and users paste exactly this.

source_url.description: Where it came from. Required: this is what makes an item evidence rather than opinion.

label_a.description: Annotator A's independent label, BEFORE discussion. Required to compute Cohen's kappa. Omit only for synthetic fixtures.

label_b.description: Annotator B's independent label, BEFORE discussion.

resolved_by.description: Third annotator. Set only when label_a != label_b.

campaign.description: Optional grouping key for items from one scam campaign or one company. Used to detect near-duplicates that would inflate metrics.

synthetic.description: True marks a fabricated fixture. Any file containing one is refused by the fusion trainer and stamped unreportable.
